headline: Alupar and Axia Energia Swap Grid Stakes in $66.5 Million Transaction
summary: Brazilian power firms Alupar and Axia Energia signed contracts to split two grid companies, with Axia paying about $66.5 million.
why: Asset restructuring and grid stake swaps among power utilities streamline transmission operations and corporate asset portfolios.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Grid asset realignment between utilities optimizes local power transmission management.
